themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: The AfD's strong polling in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, alongside Vox's mobilizations in Spain over Ceuta, signals a coordinated far-right push for regional power. Parallel debates in Germany, Spain, and Italy reflect a shared focus on migration, sovereignty, and institutional control.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, with debates on migration, education, and potential governance. Articles highlight economic and social policy shifts if AfD wins.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox organizes nationwide protests and parliamentary actions over Ceuta’s migrant crisis, accusing Spain’s government of treason and demanding EU intervention. Strong cross-border framing with Morocco.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Internal Lega tensions over Salvini’s leadership and electoral reforms mirror broader far-right struggles for cohesion. Nationalist rhetoric on sovereignty and migration aligns with AfD and Vox.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s focus on national sovereignty (e.g., veil bans, migration) and internal power dynamics (Le Pen vs. Bardella) parallel themes in Germany and Spain.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Ceuta’s migrant crisis dominates Spanish right-wing discourse, with Vox and PP framing it as a national security threat and accusing the government of complicity. Similar themes emerge in Germany (AfD’s anti-migration platform) and France (RN’s veil ban proposals), tying border control to cultural identity.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leads protests in Brussels and Madrid over Ceuta, demanding EU action and framing migration as an invasion. Articles emphasize sovereignty threats and jihadist risks.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD’s Saxony-Anhalt campaign centers on deportations, anti-asylum policies, and opposition to foreign workers, aligning with Vox’s Ceuta narrative.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN’s proposal to ban veils in public spaces and penalize migrants frames immigration as a cultural and security issue, echoing Vox’s rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega’s focus on security and anti-migration policies in coalition talks mirrors broader far-right priorities.

themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Trump’s administration faces lawsuits over voter data collection and media restrictions, while Reform UK’s Farage defies parliamentary rules. In Poland, PiS and allies decry alleged bias in Zondacrypto coverage, framing investigations as politically motivated.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration sued over voter data database plans and faces scrutiny for restricting press access. Articles highlight conflicts with tech platforms and media outlets.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage breaks parliamentary rules (e.g., filming on Parliament roof) and faces investigations over donations, framing it as establishment persecution.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS accuses opposition and media of weaponizing the Zondacrypto scandal, demanding apolitical investigations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government faces criticism over media control and transparency, with opposition alleging censorship.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Poland’s PiS and Hungary’s Tisza/Fidesz push for nationalist rebranding of institutions (e.g., Zondacrypto investigations, media councils). In Italy, Lega Nord dissidents seek to revive the party’s original symbol, while Trump renames geographic features (e.g., Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’).

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s executive orders rename landmarks (e.g., Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’), signaling symbolic nationalism.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government restructures media oversight and public institutions, emphasizing Hungarian sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes expert commissions to investigate scandals (e.g., Zondacrypto), framing it as restoring public trust in institutions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega Nord factions demand revival of the party’s original identity and symbolism, challenging Salvini’s leadership.

themes.title: Economic Nationalism and Trade Disputes
themes.blurb: Trump’s tariffs on Canada and Venezuela oil deals spark retaliation debates, while Poland’s PiS and Hungary’s Tisza push for economic sovereignty (e.g., EU budget negotiations, reparations from Germany). Argentina’s Milei leverages Trump’s Falklands remarks to assert economic independence.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump imposes tariffs on Canada (50%) and expands Venezuelan oil production, framing it as ‘America First’ economic policy.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Poland demands WWII reparations from Germany and resists EU climate policies, emphasizing national economic control.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary negotiates EU budget terms and resists migration-related fines, prioritizing national economic interests.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei uses Trump’s Falklands stance to bolster Argentina’s sovereignty claims, tying economic and diplomatic leverage.
